shortDescription: According to Nikkei Asia, Fujitsu will begin exporting AI semiconductors developed with technology used in its supercomputer Fugaku to the U.S. and Asia as early as next year. The Japanese company is applying technology from Fugaku, one of the world's fastest supercomputers, to the chips.

title: Fujitsu To Export AI Semiconductors To U.S. And Asia Next Year
